question: Who has assumed the charge as Chairperson, International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA) from August 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**K. Rajaraman**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **K. Rajaraman** has assumed the charge as Chairperson, International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA) from August 2023.
 
• He succeeded Injeti Srinivas, who was the first Chairperson of the IFSCA.
 
• K. Rajaraman is an IAS officer of the Tamil Nadu cadre, with extensive experience in public administration and policy formulation.
 
• The IFSCA is a statutory body established by the Government of India to regulate and develop financial services, financial products, and financial institutions in the International Financial Services Centres (IFSCs) in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The International Financial Services Centres Authority (IFSCA) was established in April 2020 under the International Financial Services Centres Authority Act, 2019.
 
• Its headquarters is located at GIFT City, Gandhinagar, Gujarat.
 
• The IFSCA aims to promote ease of doing business in the IFSC and provide a world-class regulatory environment.
 
• It regulates all financial services in the IFSC, which includes banking, capital markets, insurance, and fund management.
 
• The establishment of IFSCA is a significant step towards making India a global financial hub.
